en: The image shows a wintry riverside scene. The river is partially frozen with chunks of ice floating on the surface. There is a snow-covered embankment or walkway on the right, with a couple of people walking along it. Industrial-looking buildings and possibly warehouses are visible across the river, with a cityscape in the background. The overall image is sepia-toned, giving it an old-fashioned feel.
